description: A research source that reports or generates evidence — e.g. an experiment, study, dataset, book, conference paper, or journal article. A source DESCRIBES the study it reports (tech.scios.rrgi.describes), and that study GROUNDS the evidence (tech.scios.rrgi.grounds) — the provenance spine source → describes → study → grounds → evidence; there is no single-hop source→evidence relation (MIRA's own direct link runs the other way, evidence → source document, and is accepted beside the spine since 2026-10-03 as tech.scios.rrgi.sourceDocument; extractors keep writing the spine). Grounded in the MIRA community schema (github.com/MIRA-science/schema, mira.yaml, SourceDocument — is_a CreativeWork); first ported (2026-05) from the DiscourseGraphs coalition's OWL (github.com/DiscourseGraphs/schemas, dg:Source) — historical lineage, kept as attribution. Dual-addressing of every reference is an RRGI extension intended to be proposed upstream.

text.description: Human-readable title or citation for the source.

sourceType.description: The kind of source. Open to community-specific extension.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier for the source, if any.

url.description: URL for the source, if any.

description.description: Optional additional context about the source (methods, edition, venue, etc.).
